open_questions: Does consent VL-LEGACY-CORPUS-2026-08-10 reach non-MIT public OSS? The charter says 'public MIT source and dependencies', yet react-your-spotify-1-5-0 (GPL-3.0) is already in the corpus under it and acquire.ts applies no SPDX filter; against that, jaeger-ui/saleor-dashboard/appsmith/strapi were each originally acquired under their own purpose-bound consent (T680/T670/T685/T687). Owner ruling needed before the T045 react backlog can proceed: either broaden the corpus consent, or mint per-app grants. Strapi v3.6.8 is separately unclear (SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE, split terms) and should stay excluded either way.

react-verdaccio should be struck from the react candidate list entirely: at v4.12.2 the UI ships from a separate package and the tree declares no react dependency. Should the remaining candidate list be re-screened by reading each manifest at its pin from the journals already on disk, before any further acquire spend?
